capabilities: Highlight PDF text in five colors
Add text boxes, sticky notes and pen drawings
Save annotations into the PDF file as standard PDF annotations
Autosave edits about two seconds after changes
Copy the original PDF to a backups folder before first save
extras: Desktop only; makes no network requests; backups in .obsidian/plugins/pdf-markup/backups/ are never deleted automatically; encrypted PDFs cannot be rewritten for sticky notes; early release 0.1.0 with drawing and highlight comments less tested.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer cannot add highlights, notes, text or drawings that persist inside the PDF file for use in other apps.

relations.evidence: Mendeley Integration, which can download a reference's PDF into your vault so you can mark it up here.
in a viewer inspired by macOS Preview

summary: PDF viewer that adds highlights, sticky notes, text boxes and drawings, saving them as standard annotations inside the PDF file itself.
